basis: New R&D engineering rubric, not numerically comparable with earlier research-priority scores. Ratings are editorial anchors 0,.25,.5,.75,1, not measured probabilities.

tasks.why: Paired supervised tabletop observations with known arrival cards; compare independently labeled observations and decisions. Mandatory empirical evidence gate.
Independent student derivation and replay; assess comprehension and record disagreements before releasing key.
Replace single residual-stock score with queue equity, terminal residual and service targets; characterize Pareto tradeoff with same actions and priors, rather than tuning for a large gain.
Fit and validate measurement likelihood and timestamp availability on independent approved tabletop labels or documented aggregate data. No invented sensor-error rates.
Cross-check independent small discrete-event model with finite receiving storage, different arrivals and service; matched constraints and classwise comparator.
Improve belief-state caching/branch bound; benchmark cold/warm runtime and memory including certificate overhead; retain slower cases.
Presentation polish after research/measurement gates; current offline viewer already usable.
More horizon-only sweeps have low marginal information after exact certification and weak strong-baseline gains.

selection: RND-OBJECTIVE next executable discriminating implementation; teacher/student evidence gates remain independent and higher priority. RND-CHANNEL requires measured labels. Stop large-improvement headline and horizon-only sweeps. Keep original research title provisional.
